excerpt.zh: [Root.GetLeaderName]在[From.Planet.GetName]的废墟中发现了一个古老的资源贮藏点。他们现在已经开始将这些物资装船运往我们的中央仓库。
excerpt.en: [Root.GetLeaderName] discovered an ancient cache of resources among the ruins on [From.Planet.GetName]. They are even now in the process of being shipped off to our central stores.
